tools.name: search_capabilities
tools.description: Search Calyban's public catalog of AI agent capabilities (MCP servers, skills, subagents, slash commands, plugins and starter kits) for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini CLI and Claude Desktop. Use it to find a tool for a job, e.g. "postgres", "browser testing", "figma".

tools.name: get_capability
tools.description: Details of one catalog item by its id (from search_capabilities): what it does, who makes it, which agents it works with and its page.
